description: The sidewalk is a narrow, continuous brick-paved walkway along both sides of the street, but it appears uneven in places and is partially constrained by parked vehicles and street fixtures. There’s limited traffic separation—cars and a van share the roadway immediately adjacent to pedestrians—with overhead utility lines and few visible barriers; shade is provided by tall trees, though lighting is not prominent. Obstacles include a utility pole and hanging laundry/fixtures near building entrances, and no clear curb ramps or other accessibility features are visible.
